items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Frist: zwei Wochen nach dem Tag der Zustellung.
items.computation: The enclosed Zustellungsurkunde (page 2) shows actual formal delivery on Fri 19 Sep 2025 ('zugestellt am 19.09.2025'), so this known receipt date is used rather than a deemed-delivery fiction. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted, so the two-week period (§ 67 Abs. 1 OWiG) starts Sat 20 Sep 2025 and would end two weeks later on Fri 3 Oct 2025 (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB). 3 Oct 2025 is Tag der Deutschen Einheit, a nationwide public holiday, so under § 43 StPO (via § 46 Abs. 1 OWiG) the deadline shifts to the next business day, Mon 6 Oct 2025.

items.title: Pay the total fine (Geldbuße, fee and costs)
items.quote: Zahlung: Gesamtbetrag binnen zwei Wochen ab Rechtskraft auf das unten angegebene Konto (Verwendungszweck: Aktenzeichen).
items.computation: Payment is due two weeks after the decision becomes final (Rechtskraft). Assuming no Einspruch is filed, the objection period ends Mon 6 Oct 2025, so Rechtskraft occurs the following day, Tue 7 Oct 2025. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB that day itself is not counted, so the two-week period runs from Wed 8 Oct 2025 and ends two weeks later on Tue 21 Oct 2025 (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB), which is a normal business day so no shift applies. This date only holds if no Einspruch is submitted by 6 Oct 2025; an Einspruch would prevent Rechtskraft and this payment obligation.

warnings: The payment deadline of 2025-10-21 assumes no Einspruch is filed by the 2025-10-06 deadline; filing an Einspruch prevents the fine from becoming final (Rechtskraft) and suspends this payment obligation.

The IBAN DE34 5205 0000 0000 0034 34 is a formally valid German IBAN, but as always the account holder should be verified independently (e.g. against the authority's official contact details) before paying.
